'''2013 Match Play Championship Day 1 Jerry Heine DS Set Your Course For Alderaan''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jerry Heine]] at [[2013 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|TA-D-setyourcourseforalderaan.gif}}
* '''Username:''' quesoSauce37
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
